paragraphs.text: And the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of the Lord, saying: Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days the Lord God finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, appointed it as a sign for all His works.
paragraphs.original: ויאמר מלאך הפנים למשה כדבר יהוה לאמר כתב את כל דברי הבריאה אשר ברא יהוה אלהים ביום ששת בכל אשר ברא וישבת ביום השביעי ויקדשהו לכל הדורות ויקבעהו לאות לכל מעשיו
paragraphs.translit: wa-yōʾmer malʾak ha-pānīm lə-Mōšeh ki-dbar YHWH lēʾmōr kətōb ʾet kol dibrē ha-bərīʾāh ʾăšer bārāʾ YHWH ʾĕlōhīm bə-yōm šēšet bə-kol ʾăšer bārāʾ wa-yišbōt ba-yōm ha-šəbīʿī wa-yəqaddəšēhū lə-kol ha-dōrōt wa-yiqbāʿēhū lə-ʾōt lə-kol maʿăśāyw

paragraphs.text: For on the first day He created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before him -the angels of the presence, and the angels of sanctification, and the angels [of the spirit of fire and the angels] of the spirit of the winds, and the angels of the spirit of the clouds, and of darkness, and of snow and of hail and of hoar frost, and the angels of the voices and of the thunder and of the lightning, and the angels of the spirits of cold and of heat, and of winter and of spring and of autumn and of summer and of all the spirits of his creatures which are in the heavens and on the earth, (He created) the abysses and the darkness, eventide <and night>, and the light, dawn and day, which prepared in the knowledge of his heart.
paragraphs.original: כי ביום הראשון ברא את השמים העליונים ואת הארץ ואת המים ואת כל הרוחות המשרתות לפניו ומלאכי הפנים ומלאכי הקדושה ומלאכי רוחות הנשמה ומלאכי רוחות העננים והחשך ומלאכי הברד ומלאכי הקרח ומלאכי הקרים ומלאכי הקיץ ומלאכי החרף ומלאכי הסתו ומלאכי הסערה ומלאכי הקול ומלאכי הרעם ומלאכי הברק ומלאכי רוחות הקור והחם והאש ומלאכי הקיצים ומלאכי האביב והחרף וכל רוחות בריותיו אשר בשמים ואשר בארץ
paragraphs.translit: kī ba-yōm hā-rīʾšōn bārāʾ ʾet ha-šāmayim hā-ʿelyōnīm wə-ʾet hā-ʾāreṣ wə-ʾet ha-mayim wə-ʾet kol hā-rūḥōt ha-məšārtōt lə-pānāyw ū-malʾăkē ha-pānīm ū-malʾăkē ha-qədūššāh ū-malʾăkē rūḥōt ha-nəšāmāh ū-malʾăkē rūḥōt hā-ʿănānīm wə-ha-ḥōšek ū-malʾăkē ha-bārād ū-malʾăkē ha-qeraḥ ū-malʾăkē ha-qārīm ū-malʾăkē ha-qayiṣ ū-malʾăkē ha-ḥōrep ū-malʾăkē ha-stāw ū-malʾăkē ha-səʿārāh ū-malʾăkē ha-qōl ū-malʾăkē hā-raʿam ū-malʾăkē ha-bārāq ū-malʾăkē rūḥōt ha-qōr wə-ha-ḥōm wə-hā-ʾēš ū-malʾăkē ha-qēṣīm ū-malʾăkē hā-ʾābīb wə-ha-ḥōrep wə-kol rūḥōt bərīyōtāyw ʾăšer ba-šāmayim wa-ʾăšer bā-ʾāreṣ

paragraphs.text: And thereupon we saw His works, and praised Him, and lauded before Him on account of all His works; for seven great works did He create on And on the second day He created the firmament in the midst of the waters, and the waters were divided on that day -half of them went up above and half of them went down below the firmament (that was) in the midst over the face of the whole earth. And this was the only work (God) created on the second day.
paragraphs.original: ואת תהומות ואת החשך ערב ובקר ואת האור ואת השחר ואת האור אשר הכין על דעתו
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʾet təhōmōt wə-ʾet ha-ḥōšek ʿereb wā-bōqer wə-ʾet hā-ʾōr wə-ʾet ha-šaḥar wə-ʾet hā-ʾōr ʾăšer hēkīn ʿal daʿtō

paragraphs.text: And on the third day He commanded the waters to pass from off the the whole earth into one place, and the dry land to appear. And the waters did so as He commanded them, and they retired from off the face of the earth into one place outside of this and the dry land appeared.
paragraphs.original: ובראותו את כל אשר עשה ויברך אותם ויברך את כל הרוחות לעבדו
paragraphs.translit: ū-birʾōtō ʾet kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh wa-yəbārek ʾōtām wa-yəbārek ʾet kol hā-rūḥōt lə-ʿābdō

paragraphs.text: And on that day He created for them all the seas according to their separate gathering-places, and all the rivers, and the gatherings of the waters in the mountains and on all the earth, and all the lakes, and all the dew of the earth, and the seed which is sown, and all sprouting things, and fruit-bearing trees, and trees of the wood, and the garden of plants after their kind These four great works God created on the third day.
paragraphs.original: ויעש ביום השני את הרקיע בתוך המים ויחלקו המים ביום ההוא חציים עלו ממעל לרקיע ההוא וחציים ירדו תחת לרקיע אשר בתוך הארץ
paragraphs.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm ha-šēnī ʾet hā-rāqīaʿ bə-tōk ha-mayim wa-yēḥālqū ha-mayim ba-yōm ha-hūʾ ḥeṣyām ʿālū mim-maʿal lā-rāqīaʿ ha-hūʾ wə-ḥeṣyām yārdū taḥat lā-rāqīaʿ ʾăšer bə-tōk hā-ʾāreṣ

paragraphs.text: And on the fourth day He created the sun and the moon and the stars, and set them in the firmament of the heaven, to give light upon all the earth, and to rule over the day and the night, light from the darkness.
paragraphs.original: וזה לבדו עשה ביום השני ויעש לכל המים מקוה אחד ולים אחד ויאסוף את הכל ויקבץ אותם ויהי מקום נגלה לכל הים
paragraphs.translit: wə-zeh lə-baddō ʿāśāh ba-yōm ha-šēnī wa-yaʿaś lə-kol ha-mayim miqweh ʾeḥād wə-lə-yām ʾeḥād wa-yeʾĕsōp ʾet ha-kōl wa-yəqabbēṣ ʾōtām wa-yhī māqōm niglāh lə-kol ha-yām

paragraphs.text: And God appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years. And it divideth the light from the darkness [and] for prosperity, that all things may prosper which shoot and grow on the earth.
paragraphs.original: ויעש ביום הזה השלישי את כל אשר עשה לים ולנהרות ולפלגים ולמעינות לטל ולמטר ולגן עדן בעדן ולכל
paragraphs.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm ha-zeh ha-šəlīšī ʾet kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh la-yām wə-la-nəhārōt wə-la-pəlāgīm wə-la-maʿănōt la-ṭal wə-la-māṭār wə-lə-gan ʿēden bə-ʿēden wə-la-kōl

paragraphs.text: These three kinds He made on the fourth day. And on the fifth day He created great sea monsters in the depths of the waters, for these were the first things of flesh that were created by his hands, the fish and everything that moves in the waters, and everything that flies, the birds and all their kind.
paragraphs.original: ויעש ביום הרביעי את השמש ואת הירח ואת הכוכבים ויתנם ברקיע השמים להאיר על כל הארץ ולמשול ביום ובלילה ולהבדיל בין האור ובין החשך
paragraphs.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm hā-rəbīʿī ʾet ha-šemeš wə-ʾet ha-yārēaḥ wə-ʾet ha-kōkābīm wa-yittēn-ām bā-rāqīaʿ ha-šāmayim lə-hāʾīr ʿal kol hā-ʾāreṣ wə-li-mšōl ba-yōm ū-ba-laylāh wə-lə-habdīl bēn hā-ʾōr ū-bēn ha-ḥōšek

paragraphs.text: And the sun rose above them to prosper (them), and above everything that was on the earth, everything that shoots out of the earth, and all fruit-bearing trees, and all flesh. These three kinds He created on the fifth day. And on He created all the animals of the earth, and all cattle, and everything that moves on the And after all this He created man, a man and a woman created He them, and gave him dominion over all that is upon the earth, and in the seas, and over everything that flies, and over beasts and over cattle, and over everything that moves on the earth, and over the whole earth, and over all this He gave And these four kinds He created on the sixth day. And there were two and twenty kinds.
paragraphs.original: ויתן יהוה את השמש לאות גדול על הארץ לימים ולשבתות ולחדשים ולמועדים ולשנים ולשבועי שנים וליובלים ולכל תקופות השנים
paragraphs.translit: wa-yittēn YHWH ʾet ha-šemeš lə-ʾōt gādōl ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ lə-yāmīm wə-li-šabbātōt wə-la-ḥŏdāšīm wə-la-mōʿădīm wə-la-šānīm wə-li-šəbūʿē šānīm wə-la-yōbəlīm wə-lə-kol təqūpōt ha-šānīm

paragraphs.text: And He finished all his work on the sixth day -all that is in the heavens and on the earth, and in the seas and in the abysses, and in the light and in the darkness, And He gave us a great sign, the Sabbath day, that we should work six keep Sabbath on the seventh day from all work.
paragraphs.original: ויבדל בין האור ובין החשך לבריאות ויהי כן ויקרא לאור יום ולחשך קרא לילה
paragraphs.translit: wa-yabdēl bēn hā-ʾōr ū-bēn ha-ḥōšek li-brīʾūt wa-yhī kēn wa-yiqrāʾ lā-ʾōr yōm wə-la-ḥōšek qārāʾ laylāh

paragraphs.text: And all the angels of the presence, and all the angels of sanctification, these two great classes -He hath bidden us to keep the Sabbath in heaven and on earth. And He said unto us: 'Behold, I will separate unto Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these shall keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them unto Myself as My people, and will bless them; as I have sanctified the Sabbath day and do sanctify (it) unto Myself, even so will I bless them, and they shall be My people and I will be their God.
paragraphs.original: ויעש ביום החמישי את התנינים הגדולים בתוך מי תהומות כי הם נעשו ראשונה במים וכל בשר הזוחל ועוף השמים וכל אשר עף
paragraphs.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm ha-ḥămīšī ʾet ha-tannīnīm ha-gədōlīm bə-tōk mē təhōmōt kī hēm naʿăśū rīʾšōnāh ba-mayim wə-kol bāśār ha-zōḥēl wə-ʿōp ha-šāmayim wə-kol ʾăšer ʿāp

paragraphs.text: And I have chosen the seed of Jacob from amongst all that I have seen, and have written him down as My first-born son,and have sanctified him unto Myself for ever and ever; and I will teach Sabbath day, that they may keep Sabbath thereon from all work.'
paragraphs.original: ויעש ביום הששי את כל חיתו הארץ ואת כל הבהמה ואת כל אשר רומש על הארץ
paragraphs.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm ha-šiššī ʾet kol ḥaytō hā-ʾāreṣ wə-ʾet kol ha-bəhēmāh wə-ʾet kol ʾăšer rōmēś ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ

paragraphs.text: And thus He created therein a sign in accordance with which they should keep Sabbath with us on the seventh day, to eat and to drink, and to bless Him who has created all things as He has blessed and sanctified unto a peculiar people above all peoples, and that they should keep Sabbath together with And He caused His commands to ascend as a sweet savour acceptable before Him all the days There (were) two and twenty heads of mankind from Adam to Jacob, and two and twenty kinds of work were made until the seventh day; this is blessed and holy; and the former also is blessed and holy; and this one serves with that one for sanctification and blessing.
paragraphs.original: ואחרי כל זאת עשה את האדם איש ואשה עשה אותם וימשילהו על כל אשר על הארץ ובים ועל העוף ועל החיה ועל הבהמה ועל כל הארץ ועל כל אשר רומש על הארץ
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʾaḥărē kol zōʾt ʿāśāh ʾet hā-ʾādām ʾīš wə-ʾiššāh ʿāśāh ʾōtām wa-yamšīlēhū ʿal kol ʾăšer ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ ū-ba-yām wə-ʿal hā-ʿōp wə-ʿal ha-ḥayyāh wə-ʿal ha-bəhēmāh wə-ʿal kol hā-ʾāreṣ wə-ʿal kol ʾăšer rōmēś ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ

paragraphs.text: (Jacob and his seed) it was granted that they should always be the blessed and holy ones of the and law, even as He had sanctified and blessed the Sabbath day on the seventh day. created heaven and earth and everything that He created in six days, and God made the seventh day holy, for all His works; therefore He commanded on its behalf that, whoever does any work shall die, and that he who defiles it shall surely die.
paragraphs.original: ועל אלה ארבעת המינים השליטו ביום הששי וכל המעשה אשר עשה השלים ובכל אשר עשה היו עשרים ושנים מיני בריאה
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿal ʾēlleh ʾarbaʿat ha-mīnīm hišlīṭō ba-yōm ha-šiššī wə-kol ha-maʿăśeh ʾăšer ʿāśāh hišlīm ū-bə-kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh hāyū ʿeśrīm ū-šənayim mīnē bərīʾāh

paragraphs.text: Wherefore do thou command the children of Israel to observe this day that they may keep it holy and not do thereon any work, and defile it, as it is holier than all other days. And whoever profanes it shall surely die, and whoever does thereon any work shall surely die eternally, that the children of Israel may observe this day throughout their generations, and not be rooted out of the land; for it is a holy day and a And every one who observes it and keeps Sabbath thereon from all his work, will blessed throughout all days like unto us.
paragraphs.original: וישלם השם את כל מעשהו ביום השביעי ויברך אותם ויקדש אותם
paragraphs.translit: wa-yašlēm ha-šēm ʾet kol maʿăśēhū ba-yōm ha-šəbīʿī wa-yəbārek ʾōtām wa-yəqaddēš ʾōtām

paragraphs.text: Declare and say to the children of Israel the law of this day both that they should keep Sabbath thereon, and that they should not forsake it in the error of their hearts; (and) that it is not lawful to do any work thereon which is unseemly, to do thereon their own pleasure, and that they should not prepare thereon anything to be eaten or drunk, and (that it is not lawful) to draw water, or bring in or take out thereon through their gates which they had not prepared for themselves on the sixth day in their dwellings.
paragraphs.original: ככה נתן לאות לכל מעשיו אשר ברא לעשות שש ימים יעבוד וביום השביעי ישבת מכל אשר עשה
paragraphs.translit: kā-kāh nātan lə-ʾōt lə-kol maʿăśāyw ʾăšer bārāʾ la-ʿăśōt šēš yāmīm yaʿăbōd ū-ba-yōm ha-šəbīʿī yišbōt mi-kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh

paragraphs.text: they shall not bring in nor take out from house to house on that day; for that day is more holy and blessed than any jubilee day of the jubilees; on this we kept Sabbath in the heavens before it was known to any flesh to keep Sabbath thereon on the earth.
paragraphs.original: ויתן את שבתות לכל מעשיו אשר עשה ולנו לבדנו נתנם לעשות ולאכל ולשתות לפני יהוה אלהינו
paragraphs.translit: wa-yittēn ʾet šabbətōt lə-kol maʿăśāyw ʾăšer ʿāśāh wə-lā-nū lə-baddēnū nətān-ām la-ʿăśōt wə-leʾĕkōl wə-li-štōt li-pnē YHWH ʾĕlōhēnū

paragraphs.text: And the Creator of all things blessed it, but he did not sanctify all peoples and nations to keep Sabbath thereon, but Israel alone he permitted to eat and drink and to keep Sabbath thereon on the earth.
paragraphs.original: כי הוא בחר בנו מכל העמים אשר ראה לעשות עם לו ושבת קדש לכל הימים ויקדישנו לו וברכנו ויאמר אלינו ויעלה לפניו זרענו לזכר עם רוחות הקדושים והפנים אשר היו לפניו לכל הימים
paragraphs.translit: kī hūʾ bāḥar bā-nū mi-kol hā-ʿammīm ʾăšer rāʾāh la-ʿăśōt ʿam lō wə-šabbat qōdeš lə-kol ha-yāmīm wa-yəqaddīšēnū lō ū-bērkānū wa-yōʾmer ʾēlēnū wə-yaʿăleh lə-pānāyw zarʿēnū lə-zēker ʿim rūḥōt ha-qədōšīm wə-ha-pānīm ʾăšer hāyū lə-pānāyw lə-kol ha-yāmīm

paragraphs.text: Creator of all things blessed this day which He had created for blessing and holiness and glory This law and testimony was given to the children of Israel as a law for ever unto their generations.
